blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion models have shown strong potential for image matting by transferring generative priors learned from large-scale pretraining. However, existing approaches largely rely on latent diffusion models, whose compressed representations and VAE-based reconstruction introduce a mismatch with the high-frequency precision required for matting. We present PixelMatte, a framework that adapts pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers for high-fidelity image matting. We show that strong image-conditioned matting capabilities can be acquired even from a pure text-to-image model without paired image-to-image pretraining. Our approach reuses the backbone's native patch embedding to jointly process the input image, trimap, and noisy alpha matte as spatially aligned tokens, enabling direct pixel-space prediction without additional condition encoders or adapters. With pixel-accurate synthetic supervision and real-image fine-tuning, PixelMatte predicts alpha mattes in a single forward pass. Two lightweight calibration modules, LayerShift and High-Pass Refiner, further improve regional opacity accuracy and boundary fidelity. Experiments across four benchmarks and two distinct pixel diffusion backbones demonstrate substantial improvements over existing methods, reducing SAD and gradient errors by 24-44% relative to RenderMatte on P3M-500-NP and AM-2K, while achieving competitive performance on AIM-500 and RenderMatte-2K. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of pixel-space generative priors for precision-sensitive image matting. Project page: https://white-yc.github.io/pixelmatte/.
blocks.zh: 扩散模型通过转移从大规模预训中吸取的基因前科,显示出图像分解的强大潜力。 然而,现有方法在很大程度上依赖于潜在的扩散模型,其压缩表达和基于VAE的重建导致与交配所需的高频精度不相匹配. 我们提出PixelMatte,这个框架可以调整预先训练的像素-空间扩散变压器,以进行高真实度的图像交配. 我们显示,即使从纯文本到图像模型也可以获得强大的图像条件相配能力,而无需对映图像到图像的预训. 我们的方法重新使用主干线的本地补丁嵌入,共同处理输入图像,三相图,和吵闹的alpha matte作为空间对齐的符号,使得可以直接进行像素-空间预测而无需附加条件编码器或适配器. 通过像素-精确的合成监督并进行真实的图像微调,像素Matte在一次前行通道中预测出α分量. 两个轻量级校正模块"LayerShift"和"高活度炼油"(High-Pass Refineer),进一步提高了区域不透明度精度和边界忠诚度. 跨越4个基准和2个不同的像素传播主干线的实验显示,相对于现有方法,在P3M-500-NP和AM-2K上将SAD和梯度误差比RenderMatte减少24.44%,同时在AIM-500和RenderMatte-2K上实现竞争性能. 这些结果显示了像素-空间基因前缀对于精密敏感图像交配的有效性. 项目网页:https://white-yc.github.io/pixelmatte/.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Image matting estimates the per-pixel alpha matte of an arbitrary foreground object from the observed image [ 17 ] . Unlike traditional image segmentation, which assigns discrete labels, image matting is an inherently ill-posed inverse problem due to the ambiguity in recovering alpha values from a composite image [ 41 , 9 , 33 ] .
Trimap-guided matting addresses this ambiguity by introducing an auxiliary trimap that partitions the image into definite foreground, definite background, and an unknown region requiring exact alpha estimation.
The trimaps may be produced using segmentation models [ 12 , 18 , 50 ] , providing semantic and spatial guidance for image matting models to focus on recovering fine-grained details within the unknown region.
The main challenge lies in intricate structures such as hair, fur, foliage, and transparent boundaries, where accurate alpha estimation requires pixel-level precision.
Traditionally, image matting has been formulated as a supervised regression problem [ 44 , 29 , 21 , 8 , 5 , 39 , 31 , 46 , 27 , 25 ] .
More recently, generative approaches have emerged that adapt pretrained diffusion models for alpha matte prediction [ 41 , 9 , 45 , 6 , 33 , 47 ] . These methods leverage rich generative priors acquired through large-scale pretraining, which can help mitigate the effects of imperfect alpha annotations and enable generalization to diverse visual content beyond the limited distributions of existing matting datasets.
blocks.zh:
图像映射从被观测到的图像中估计出任意前缘对象的每像素α matte [17]. 与分配离散标签的传统图像分割不同,由于从复合图像中恢复α值的模棱两可[41,9,33],图像配位是一个内在的负向问题.
Trimap 制导的交配处理这个模糊性,方法是引入一个辅助的三角图,将图像分割成明确的前缘,确定的背景,以及一个需要精确的α估计的未知区域.
三角图可能使用分解模型[12,18,50]来制作,为图像交配模型提供语义和空间指导,侧重于在未知区域内回收细纹细节.
主要挑战在于毛发,毛皮,叶片等复杂结构,以及透明的边界,准确的α估计需要像素级的精确度.
传统上,图像交配被表述为监督回归问题[44、29、21、8、5、39、31、46、27、25]。
最近,出现了一些基因方法,用以调整预先经过训练的传播模型,用于α成熟度预测[41、9、45、6、33、47]。 这些方法利用通过大规模预训获得的丰富的基因前传,这可以帮助减轻不完善的α说明的影响,并使得通论能够超越现有交配数据集的有限分布,实现多样化的视觉内容.

blocks.en: However, most existing generative approaches rely on latent diffusion models [ 34 , 13 ] , creating an inherent mismatch with the pixel-level precision required for image matting. Matting is a high-frequency task, yet the network of a latent model operates on a spatially compressed representation in which hair-thin structures and opacity transitions are not represented explicitly [ 4 , 49 , 48 ] . It predicts a compressed code and is supervised at the pixel level only through a frozen decoder trained for natural images [ 43 , 51 , 20 , 42 ] . Fine details are therefore recovered indirectly, relying on the strength of the generative prior rather than on direct modeling of high-frequency alpha structure.
blocks.zh: 然而,大多数现有的基因方法都依赖于潜在扩散模型[34,13],这与图像映射所需的像素级精度形成了固有的不匹配. Matting是一项高频任务,然而潜在模型的网络在空间压缩的表示方式上运作,其中毛细结构和不透明过渡没有明确地表示[4,49,48]. 它预言一个压缩的代码,并且只在像素级别上通过为自然图像训练的冷冻解码器来监督[43,51,20,42]. 因此,精细的细节是间接回收的,依靠先基因的强度,而不是直接模拟高频α结构.

blocks.en: Recent advances in pixel-space diffusion models have made high-quality image generation directly in pixel space increasingly practical, enabled by improved prediction objectives, architectures, and training strategies [ 19 , 48 , 32 , 2 , 23 , 24 ] . In contrast to latent diffusion models, these approaches bypass VAE-based compression and reconstruction, preserving direct access to high-frequency image information that is only implicitly encoded in latent representations. This enables diffusion transformers to learn and optimize fine-grained visual structures under direct pixel-space supervision, making them particularly promising for image matting, where precise recovery of high-frequency details is essential.
blocks.zh: 最近在像素空间传播模型方面的进步,使像素空间直接生成高质量的图像变得日益实用,通过改进预测目标,架构和培训策略[19,48,32,2,23,24]得以实现. 与潜在传播模型相反,这些方法绕过基于VAE的压缩和重建,保留了直接获取高频图像信息的机会,而高频图像信息只是隐含地编码在潜在表达中. 这使得扩散变压器能够在直接的像素空间监督下学习和优化精细的纹理视觉结构,使得它们特别有希望进行图像配对,因为准确回收高频细节是必不可少的.

blocks.en: In this paper, we present PixelMatte , a simple yet effective framework for high-fidelity matting built upon pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers. We demonstrate that even a pure text-to-image model without paired image-to-image pretraining can acquire strong image-conditioned matting capabilities through supervised fine-tuning. Specifically, we directly embed the input image, trimap, and noisy alpha matte using the backbone’s native patch embedding, enabling spatially aligned conditioning without additional encoders or adapters. We adapt the pretrained models using the pixel-accurate synthetic training data of RenderMatte [ 33 ] , followed by mixed training with real images. We further introduce two lightweight calibration modules, LayerShift and High-Pass Refiner , to improve opacity accuracy and boundary fidelity, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了PixelMatte, 一种简单而有效的高纯度交配框架, 建立在预先训练的像素空间扩散变压器上。 我们证明,即使一个纯文本到图像模型,没有成对的图像到图像预训,也能通过有监督的微调,获得强大的图像条件配制能力. 具体来说,我们直接使用主干线的本地补丁嵌入来嵌入输入图像、三映射和吵闹的alpha matte,从而可以在不增加编码器或适配器的情况下进行空间对齐的调节。 我们使用RenderMatte的像素精确合成训练数据来调整预先训练的模型,然后用真实图像进行混合训练。 我们进一步采用了两个轻量级校准模块,即LayerShift和High-Pass炼油厂,分别提高不透明度准确度和边界忠诚度。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce PixelMatte , a framework that adapts pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers to image matting by reusing the backbone’s native patch embedding for spatially aligned image and trimap conditioning. It needs no VAE, condition encoder or adapter, predicts the matte in a single step, and works even for a pure text-to-image backbone (PRXPixel [ 32 ] ) without paired image-to-image pretraining. • We propose two lightweight calibration modules: LayerShift , learned per-layer shifts that adjust regional opacity levels inside the frozen backbone, and the High-Pass Refiner , a small high-pass-constrained residual network that sharpens boundary transitions. • With two pixel diffusion backbones, PixelMatte achieves state-of-the-art results on P3M-500-NP and AM-2K, reducing the SAD of RenderMatte [ 33 ] from 6.2 to 4.3 and from 6.5 to 4.4, and competitive results on AIM-500 and RenderMatte-2K.
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们引入 PixelMatte , 这个框架将预先训练过的像素空间扩散变压器通过重用主干器的本地补丁嵌入来进行空间对齐的图像和三映图配置来适应图像的映射。 它不需要VAE,条件编码器或适配器,在单步中预言了垫子,甚至对纯文本到图像主干线(PRXPixel [32])没有成对的图像到图像预训. ^ 我们提出两个轻量级校准模块:LayerShift, 调整冷冻骨干内区域不透明水平的每层学习到的变换, 高压炼油机, 一个能磨合边界过渡的小型高通紧固残余网络。 • 支助 PixelMatte凭借两个像素扩散主干线,在P3M-500-NP和AM-2K上实现了最先进的成绩,将RenderMatte[33]的SAD从6.2降至4.3,从6.5降至4.4,并在AIM-500和RenderMatte-2K上实现了竞争成绩.

blocks.en: We introduce PixelMatte , a framework that adapts pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers to image matting by reusing the backbone’s native patch embedding for spatially aligned image and trimap conditioning. It needs no VAE, condition encoder or adapter, predicts the matte in a single step, and works even for a pure text-to-image backbone (PRXPixel [ 32 ] ) without paired image-to-image pretraining.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of PixelMatte. (a) Latent diffusion matting predicts the matte as a latent code between a frozen VAE encoder and a frozen VAE decoder. (b) PixelMatte embeds the noisy matte, the image and the trimap as pixel tokens on a shared grid and predicts the matte in a single forward pass without a VAE. LayerShift acts inside the backbone, and the High-Pass Refiner refines the predicted matte.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Deep Image Matting [ 44 ] established a learning-based framework for trimap-guided alpha estimation and introduced the Composition-1k benchmark. Subsequent methods improved alpha regression through learned feature indexing [ 29 ] , guided contextual attention [ 21 ] , attention-based representations [ 31 ] , and pretrained vision transformers with detail-capture modules [ 46 ] . Real-image datasets, including P3M-10k [ 14 ] , AM-2K [ 16 ] , and AIM-500 [ 15 ] , have further advanced the evaluation of matting in diverse natural scenes. These approaches primarily learn direct alpha regression from matting-specific supervision, with high-frequency details recovered through task-specific architectures and image features. In contrast, PixelMatte explores transferring pretrained pixel-space generative priors to fine-grained alpha prediction.
blocks.zh: 深图像马定 [44] 建立了基于学习的三映射导阿尔法估计框架,并引入了Constitution-1k基准. 随后的方法通过学习的特征索引[29],引导背景关注[21],基于关注的表达[31],以及预训的带有细节捕捉模块的视觉变换器[46],改善了α回归. 包括P3M-10k [14],AM-2K [16],以及AIM-500 [15]在内的真实图像数据集,进一步推进了对不同自然场景中交配的评价. 这些方法主要从配位特定监管中直接学习α回归,通过任务特定架构和图像特征回收高频细节. 与之相对的是,PixelMatte探索了将预先训练过的像素-空间基因前传到精致的α预测.

blocks.en: The success of pretrained diffusion models has motivated their adaptation to dense visual prediction tasks [ 11 , 43 , 7 , 30 , 35 ] . In image matting, Matting by Generation [ 41 ] formulates alpha estimation as conditional generation using pretrained latent diffusion priors, while DRIP [ 20 ] extends latent diffusion to joint foreground and alpha prediction with a dedicated transparency decoder. DiffMatte [ 9 ] instead introduces iterative pixel-level diffusion refinement using a lightweight decoder, and SDMatte [ 10 ] adapts Stable Diffusion for visual-prompt-guided interactive matting. More recently, RenderMatte [ 33 ] fine-tunes FLUX.1 Kontext [ 13 ] , an image-editing model pretrained on paired image-to-image data, for trimap-guided matting, combining pixel-accurate synthetic supervision with alpha-edge losses and group-relative alignment. While these methods demonstrate the effectiveness of diffusion-based matting, approaches built upon pretrained latent image generators rely on compressed representations and decoder-based reconstruction. PixelMatte instead fine-tunes pixel-space generative backbones with the supervised recipe of RenderMatte and requires no image-editing backbone: PRXPixel is a pure text-to-image model.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的传播模型的成功促使它们适应密集的视觉预测任务[11,43,7,30,35]. 在图像映射中,Matting by General [41] 使用预先训练的潜在扩散前缀将α估计作为条件生成,而DRIP [20] 将潜在扩散延伸至联合前缘和α预测,并配有专用的透明度解码器. DiffMatte [9] 转而使用轻量级解码器引入迭代像素级扩散精度,SDMatte [10] 将Stable Difusion用于视觉-即时-导交互交配. 最近,RenderMatte[33]微调FLUX.1 Kontext[13],一种图像编辑模型在配对的图像到图像数据上预先训练,用于三映图制导的交配,将像素精确的合成监督与α-尖端损耗和群相对对齐相结合. 虽然这些方法表明基于扩散的配制是有效的,但基于预先训练的潜在图像生成器的方法依赖于压缩的表示和基于解码器的重建。 PixelMatte 代替 微调像素- 空间基因骨干, 配有 RenderMatte 的受监督食谱, 不需要图像编辑骨干 : PRX 缩写 像素是一种纯文本对映模型.

blocks.en: Recent advances in pixel-space diffusion have demonstrated high-quality image generation without pretrained VAEs [ 3 , 40 ] . JiT [ 19 ] revisits direct pixel prediction with large-patch transformers, while PixelDiT [ 48 ] combines patch-level generation with pixel-level detail modeling. PRXPixel [ 32 ] and HiDream-O1-Image [ 2 ] extend pixel-space diffusion to large-scale image generation. Beyond generation, PixRestore [ 38 ] develops a pixel-space diffusion transformer trained from scratch for image restoration, incorporating feature-based conditioning for detail recovery. PixelControl [ 22 ] explores pixel-space controllable generation with additional structure-aware condition injection to improve fine-grained spatial fidelity. In contrast to these task-specific architectures, PixelMatte directly repurposes pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers for image-conditioned alpha estimation. By reusing their native patch embedding for spatially aligned image and trimap conditioning, our framework avoids additional conditioning encoders or adapters while enabling direct pixel-space matting.
blocks.zh: 最近在像素-空间传播方面的进步表明,在没有预先训练的VAEs[3,40]的情况下,产生了高质量的图像. JiT [19] 重新用大patch变压器进行直接像素预测,而PixelDIT [48] 将补丁级生成与像素级细节建模相结合. PRXPixel [32] 和 HiDream-O1-Image [2] 扩展像素-空间传播到大规模图像生成. PixRestore [38] 开发一个从零开始训练用于图像恢复的像素空间扩散变压器,其中包含基于特性的用于细节恢复的调制. Pixel Control [22] 探索像素-空间可控生成,并附加结构感知条件注射,以改善精细的空间忠诚度. 与这些任务特异性架构形成对比的是,PixelMatte直接重用预先训练的像素空间扩散变压器进行图像条件化的α估计. 通过重新使用它们本地的补丁嵌入来进行空间对齐的图像和三映射调制,我们的框架避免了附加的调制编码器或适配器,同时允许直接像素-空间的调制.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Latent diffusion matting introduces a representation mismatch between compressed latent features and the high-frequency precision required for image matting ( Fig. 2 a). In contrast, PixelMatte adapts pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers to predict and supervise alpha mattes directly in pixel space, without VAE-based reconstruction ( Fig. 2 b). We reuse the backbone’s native patch embedding to jointly process the input image, trimap, and noisy alpha matte as spatially aligned tokens ( Sec. 3.1 ). The model is fine-tuned in two stages and performs alpha estimation in a single forward pass ( Sec. 3.2 ). Finally, LayerShift ( Sec. 3.3 ) and the High-Pass Refiner ( Sec. 3.4 ) further calibrate regional opacity levels and boundary transitions, respectively.
blocks.zh: 线性扩散配对引入了压缩潜质特征与图像配对所需的高频精度之间的表现不匹配(图2a). 相比之下,PixelMatte调整了预先训练的像素空间扩散变压器,以在像素空间中直接预测和监督α mattes,没有基于VAE的重建(图2b). 我们重新使用主干线的本地补丁嵌入,共同处理输入图像、三角图和吵闹的alpha matte作为空间对齐的符号(第3.1节)。 该模型分两个阶段进行微调,并在一次前传中进行α估计(第3.2节)。 最后,LearsShift(第3.3节)和High-Pass炼油厂(第3.4节)分别进一步校准区域不透明水平和边界过渡.

blocks.en:
A latent matting model obtains its image condition from the VAE, whose code of the image is appended to the noisy latent.
To adapt pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers for image-conditioned matting, we reuse their native patch embedding to encode the input image and trimap alongside the noisy target matte.
Unlike latent approaches that encode image conditions through a VAE [ 33 ] , our formulation requires no separate condition encoder or adapter.
Specifically, we concatenate the three patch-token sequences: S = [ E ⁡ ( x σ ) ; E ⁡ ( I ) + s ; E ⁡ ( T ¯ ) + s ] , S=\big[\,E(x_{\sigma})\;;\;E(I)+s\;;\;E(\bar{T})+s\,\big], (2) For PRX, s s is a learned vector initialized to zero and shared across all condition tokens; HiDream uses no such vector ( s = 0 s=0 ) and instead distinguishes the three segments along the temporal axis of its rotary positional encoding.
The segments share the same spatial grid, so corresponding tokens at position ( i , j ) (i,j) receive identical spatial rotary coordinates.
This alignment enables joint self-attention to directly associate target tokens with image and trimap tokens at corresponding locations.
The pretrained HiDream backbone can already exploit this spatial correspondence before matting fine-tuning, as demonstrated in our reference reconstruction experiment.
With a fixed text prompt, the target tokens are projected directly into pixel patches, enabling alpha prediction and supervision without an intermediate VAE decoder.

The first term is equivalent to a weighted velocity-based flow-matching loss, since the velocity prediction error equals the clean-target prediction error divided by σ \sigma , yielding the factor 1 / σ 2 1/\sigma^{2} .
In the latent baseline ℒ AE \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AE}} is applied to a VAE-decoded estimate; here it supervises the prediction directly at pixel level, with no decoder in between.

Both backbones are fine-tuned with all transformer weights in two stages. The synthetic stage uses the synthetic composite training set of RenderMatte [ 33 ] , which provides accurate alpha supervision. To bridge the synthetic-to-real domain gap, the shorter real-data stage retains synthetic composites for 75% of the samples and draws the remaining 25% from the P3M-10k [ 14 ] and AM-2K [ 16 ] training splits.

blocks.en: 3.3 LayerShift for Alpha-Level Calibration
blocks.zh: 3.3 阿尔法级校准的图层Shift

blocks.en:
LayerShift is designed to calibrate regional alpha-level offsets through lightweight modifications to the frozen backbone.
Let h ℓ , n ∈ ℝ C h_{\ell,n}\in\mathbb{R}^{C} be the hidden state of target token n n in layer ℓ \ell after the second normalization and before the MLP, and let u n ∈ { 0 , 1 } u_{n}\in\{0,1\} indicate whether its patch overlaps the unknown region.
LayerShift adds one learned vector b ℓ ∈ ℝ C b_{\ell}\in\mathbb{R}^{C} per layer to these target tokens, h ℓ , n ← h ℓ , n + u n b ℓ , ℓ = 1 , … , L . h_{\ell,n}\;\leftarrow\;h_{\ell,n}+u_{n}\,b_{\ell},\qquad\ell=1,\dots,L. (6) The vectors are trained for 300 steps at σ = 1 \sigma=1 with ℒ AE \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AE}} while the backbone stays frozen; for HiDream this is L × C = 36 × 4096 = 147,456 L\times C=36\times 4096=147{,}456 parameters.
Shared across images and spatial locations, these vectors provide a compact, input-independent parameterization for calibrating regional alpha levels; their effect on the output still depends on the activations of the backbone.

blocks.en: 3.4 High-Pass Refiner for Boundary Calibration
blocks.zh: 3.4 边界校准高精炼器

blocks.en:
The High-Pass Refiner targets the edge-profile term with a small residual network whose output passes through a high-pass operator.
Correcting an overly smooth transition often involves changes of opposite sign on the two sides of an edge, rather than a uniform shift of the alpha values.
We encourage such corrections through the architecture rather than through the loss: for a residual field D D , 𝒫 hp 𝒰 ​ ( D ) = m 𝒰 ⊙ ( D − G σ h ∗ ( m 𝒰 ⊙ D ) max ⁡ ( G σ h ∗ m 𝒰 , η ) ) , \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{hp}}^{\mathcal{U}}(D)\;=\;m_{\mathcal{U}}\odot\Big(D-\frac{G_{\sigma_{h}}\ast(m_{\mathcal{U}}\odot D)}{\max(G_{\sigma_{h}}\ast m_{\mathcal{U}},\,\eta)}\Big), (7) where m 𝒰 m_{\mathcal{U}} is the binary mask of the unknown region, G σ h G_{\sigma_{h}} is a Gaussian kernel with standard deviation σ h = 24 \sigma_{h}=24 px, and η = 10 − 3 \eta=10^{-3} .
By subtracting the mask-normalized local mean of D D , the operator suppresses slowly varying corrections and retains localized ones, which encourages boundary refinement rather than regional shifts of the alpha level.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate PixelMatte with two pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers, PRX-7B (PRXPixel [ 32 ] ) and HiDream-O1-Image 8B [ 2 ] .
Both follow the fine-tuning procedure of Sec. 3.2 ; PRX operates at 1024 2 1024^{2} , while HiDream is adapted to 2048 2 2048^{2} for its final training stages and inference.
PixelMatte (PRX-7B) and PixelMatte (HiDream-8B) denote the complete models with LayerShift and the High-Pass Refiner.
Inference is a single forward pass without test-time augmentation, and we report results averaged over two independently evaluated noise seeds.
On a single H200 GPU, PRX and HiDream take 0.46 s at 1024 2 1024^{2} and 0.64 s at 2048 2 2048^{2} , respectively, compared with 0.91 s for RenderMatte at 1024 2 1024^{2} .
blocks.zh:
我们用两个预先训练过的像素空间扩散变压器——PRX-7B(PRXPixel [32])和HiDream-O1-Image 8B[2]——来评价PixelMatte.
两者都遵循第3.2sec.的微调程序;PRX运行于1024 2 1024^{2},而HiDream则适应于2048 2 2048^{2}用于其最后的训练阶段和推论.
PixelMatte(PRX-7B)和PixelMatte(HiDream-8B)表示带有LyewsShift和High-Pass炼油器的完整模型.
推论是一次没有试验时间增强的向前传球,我们报告的结果平均是两个独立评价的噪音种子。
在单一的H200 GPU上,PRX和HiDream分别取0.46 s 1024 2 1024^{2}和0.64 s 2048 2 2048^{2},而RenderMatte的0.91 s 1024 2 1024^{2}.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on P3M-500-NP [ 14 ] , AM-2K [ 16 ] , AIM-500 [ 15 ] and RenderMatte-2K (RM-2K) [ 33 ] , using their released trimaps.
We report SAD, MSE ( × 10 3 \times 10^{3} ), Grad and Conn.
In Tab. 1 , Conn follows the implementation released with RenderMatte for consistency with the published results; the remaining tables use the definition of DIM [ 44 ] .
We compare against representative supervised and diffusion-based matting methods using the published results collected by RenderMatte [ 33 ] .

我们对P3M-500-NP[14],AM-2K[16],AIM-500[15]和RenderMatte-2K(RM-2K)[33]的评价,使用他们释放的三角图.
我们报告SAD,MSE(x10 3\times 10^{3}),Grad和Conn.
在 Tab. 1 中,Conn 跟踪与 RenderMatte 发布的执行,以便与公布的结果保持一致;其余的表格使用 DIM [44] 的定义.
我们利用RenderMatte所收集的公布结果,比较了具有代表性的有监督和传播的配制方法。

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison Experiments
blocks.zh: 4.2 比较实验

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares PixelMatte with existing matting methods on the four benchmarks.
On P3M-500-NP and AM-2K, which are in-domain for our real-data stage, PixelMatte (HiDream-8B) reduces SAD and Grad by 30–44% relative to RenderMatte, and PixelMatte (PRX-7B), which runs at the same 1024 2 1024^{2} resolution as RenderMatte, by 24–38%.
These gains are already evident in the one-step predictions before calibration, and the HiDream model trained only in the synthetic stage already achieves a lower Grad than RenderMatte on all three real-image benchmarks.
On AIM-500, both backbones reduce Grad by 24–31%, indicating improved accuracy in fine spatial transitions.
On the synthetic RM-2K benchmark, PixelMatte performs comparably to RenderMatte.
These results show that pixel-space diffusion is an effective alternative to latent generative matting, particularly on fine structures in real images.
blocks.zh:
表1比较了PixelMatte与四个基准上的现有交配方法.
在P3M-500-NP和AM-2K上,PixelMatte(HiDream-8B)将SAD和Grad相对RenderMatte减少30-44%,PixelMatte(PRX-7B)的分辨率与RenderMatte相同,减少24-38%。
这些收益在校准前的单步预测中已经很明显,仅在合成阶段训练的HiDream模型在所有三个真象基准上已经实现了低于RenderMatte的Grad.
在AIM-500上,两个骨干将Grad减少24–31%,表明精细空间过渡的精度提高.
在合成的RM-2K基准上,PixelMatte的性能与RenderMatte相当.
这些结果表明,像素-空间扩散是潜在基因配体的有效替代品,特别是在真实图像中的细结构上.

blocks.zh: 表4:按地真α值和轮廓距离(HiDream-8B)分列的RM-2K上的SAD。 价值是对总计的添加剂贡献,最多四舍五入。 低点更好

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Visualization of opacity and boundary calibration. Each row compares the alpha mattes before and after a calibration module against the ground truth. Error maps show prediction minus ground truth, while correction maps show the matte after minus before, using a shared color scale. LayerShift adjusts regional opacity levels (top), whereas the High-Pass Refiner concentrates its corrections around fine boundaries (middle and bottom).
blocks.zh: 图5:不透明与边界校准的可视化. 每行比较一个校准模块之前和之后的alpha mattes与地面真理. 错误地图显示预测负地面真理,而修正地图则使用共享的颜色尺度,在最小后显示matte. LayerShift调整了区域不透明度水平(顶级),而High-Pass炼油厂则将其校正集中在细的边界(中下).

blocks.en:
On HiDream-8B, LayerShift reduces the RM-2K SAD from 3.74 to 3.66 with only 147K trainable parameters, and the High-Pass Refiner alone reaches 3.38.
Combining both modules reduces SAD to 3.31 and improves all four metrics ( Tab. 2 ).
The refiner maintains a similar relative SAD improvement when combined with LayerShift, indicating that boundary refinement remains effective after opacity calibration.
The combined calibration also improves PRX-7B on all four metrics, reducing its SAD from 3.60 to 3.46.
On the real-image benchmarks, the High-Pass Refiner further reduces the SAD of the LayerShift-calibrated HiDream predictions by 3.7%, 5.2% and 2.1% on P3M-500-NP, AM-2K and AIM-500, respectively.
blocks.zh:
在HiDream-8B上,LyerShift将RM-2K SAD从3.74降低到3.66,只有147K的可列车参数,而仅高Pass炼油机就达到了3.38.
将这两个模块合并后,SAD减少到3.31,并改进了所有四个度量标准(Tab. 2 )。
提炼器在与LyewsShift结合时保持类似的相对的SAD改进,表明不透明校准后边界的完善依然有效.
综合校准还改进了所有四个度量的PRX-7B,使其SAD从3.60降至3.46.
在真实图像基准上,高Pass炼油机在P3M-500-NP,AM-2K和AIM-500上分别进一步将图层校准的Hidream预测SAD减少3.7%,5.2%和2.1%.

blocks.en:
We examine how the High-Pass Refiner uses RGB information by replacing its image input at inference or retraining it without RGB ( Tab. 3 ).
On RM-2K, replacing the image with an unrelated one preserves about 95% of the refiner’s SAD improvement, and the refiner retrained without RGB performs comparably (3.29 versus 3.32).
On the three real-image benchmarks, the RGB-free refiner retains 68–75% of the improvement of the full input.
The refiner thus calibrates boundaries already predicted by the backbone rather than re-estimating the matte from the image, with RGB providing additional benefits on real images, so the fine structures of the final matte originate from the pixel-space backbone.
blocks.zh:
我们研究高Pass炼油厂如何使用RGB信息,在推论中取代其图像输入,或者在不使用RGB(Tab. 3)的情况下对其进行再培训.
在RM-2K上,将图像替换为不相关的图像保留了提炼器95%的SAD改进,而提炼器在没有RGB(3.29比3.32)的情况下再训练的性能可比较.
在三个真象基准上,RGB自由精炼机保留了68–75%的全输入改进.
精细器由此校准了主干线已经预测的边界,而不是从图像中重新估计matte,RGB为真实图像提供了额外的好处,因此最终matte的精细结构来源于像素-空间主干线.

blocks.en: 4.4 Analysis and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.4 分析和讨论

blocks.en:
Table 4 decomposes SAD by the ground-truth alpha value and the distance to the contour.
LayerShift provides modest improvements across all pixel subsets, consistent with its role in regional opacity calibration.
In contrast, the High-Pass Refiner achieves its largest gains near hard boundaries: on saturated pixels within 3 px of the contour, the SAD contribution decreases from 0.54 after LayerShift to 0.23 after refinement. Figure 5 further distinguishes the two behaviors: LayerShift adjusts opacity over extended regions, whereas the High-Pass Refiner introduces localized corrections along object contours.
blocks.zh:
表4按地真α值和与轮廓的距离分解了SAD.
LayerShift在所有像素子集中提供适度的改进,符合其在区域不透明校准中的作用.
相比之下,High-Pass炼油厂在硬边界附近取得了最大的收益:在轮廓3px范围内的饱和像素上,SAD的贡献从LyewsShift之后的0.54降至完善后的0.23. 图5进一步区分了两种行为: LayerShift在扩展区域上调整不透明,而High-Pass Fineer则按照对象轮廓引入局部校正.

blocks.en:
We further apply the same refiner architecture to RenderMatte, a latent diffusion matting model; each refiner is trained on the predictions of its own backbone using only RenderMatte’s synthetic composite training set ( Tab. 5 ).
Both models benefit from refinement on all four benchmarks.
On RM-2K, the refiner reduces the SAD of HiDream from 3.74 to 3.37 and that of RenderMatte from 3.33 to 3.28, which shows that learned boundary calibration applies to different generative matting backbones.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步将同样的精密结构应用于RenderMatte,一种潜在的扩散分解模型;每个精密器都只使用RenderMatte的合成复合训练集(Tab. 5)来进行自身骨干预测的培训。
这两个模式都受益于所有四项基准的完善。
在RM-2K上,精制器将HiDream的SAD从3.74降低到3.37,将RenderMatte的SAD从3.33降低到3.28,这表明所学的边界校准适用于不同的基因交配骨干.

blocks.en: Table 5 : High-Pass Refiner on a pixel-space and a latent one-step model (SAD); each refiner is trained on its own backbone’s predictions with RenderMatte’s synthetic training set. Lower is better.
blocks.zh: 表5:一个像素空间上的高压炼油器和一个潜在的单步模型(SAD);每个炼油器都通过RenderMatte的合成训练集来进行自己的骨干预测培训。 低点更好

blocks.en:
Although direct pixel-space prediction removes the compressed latent representation and its decoder, it does not remove the limitations of generative pretraining or of matting supervision.
PixelMatte inherits visual priors learned primarily for image synthesis, which may not fully capture the opacity characteristics of challenging materials: we observe residual low-amplitude alpha in saturated regions on RM-2K and noise-seed sensitivity for some transparent objects on AIM-500.
Our calibration modules, which are trained separately for each backbone, improve regional opacity and boundary transitions but do not resolve every such error.
blocks.zh:
虽然直接的像素空间预测可以去除压缩的潜在代表及其解码器,但并不能去除基因预演或交配监督的局限性.
像素 Matte继承了主要为图像合成而学习的视觉前传,这些前传可能无法完全捕捉到挑战性材料的不透明度特征:我们观测到RM-2K饱和区域中残留的低照率α和AIM-500上一些透明物体的噪声种子敏感性.
我们的校准模块为每个骨干单独培训,改善了区域不透明性和边界过渡,但没有解决所有此类错误。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented PixelMatte, demonstrating that pretrained pixel-space diffusion models can be effectively adapted to high-fidelity image matting through simple spatially aligned conditioning and task-specific supervision. By directly predicting alpha mattes in pixel space, our approach avoids VAE-based reconstruction while retaining the visual priors acquired during generative pretraining. Lightweight opacity and boundary calibration modules further improve prediction fidelity, yielding strong results across two distinct diffusion backbones and multiple matting benchmarks. Our findings suggest that pixel-space generative foundation models offer a promising alternative to latent diffusion for precision-sensitive dense prediction tasks, extending their potential beyond image synthesis.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了PixelMatte,演示了预先训练的像素空间扩散模型可以通过简单的空间对齐调节和任务特定监督,有效地适应高真度图像的交配. 通过直接预测像素空间中的α mattes,我们的方法避免了基于VAE的重建,同时保留了在基因预训过程中获得的视觉前缀. 轻量级不透明度和边界校准模块进一步提高了预测忠心度,在两个截然不同的传播主干线和多个交配基准之间取得了强有力的成果. 我们的研究结果表明,像素-空间基因基础模型为精确敏感的密集预测任务提供了一种有希望的替代潜在扩散方式,将其潜力扩展到图像合成之外。
